tasks.title: Complete Tiberian Dawn and Covert Operations content delivery gate
tasks.owner: Era integration lead with separate content specialists and reviewer
tasks.scope: Deliver and independently accept the complete approved content family for Tiberian Dawn and Covert Operations. This is a delivery-gate owner; implementation must be delegated to the generated bounded per-faction/per-entity leaves. It is not permission to ask one weak worker to build the whole family in one turn.
non_goals: Do not reproduce full original campaigns or an FPS/mobile metagame without an explicit scope decision.
Do not substitute a generic reskin, unlicensed source asset or partial roster.
steps: Read the accepted, pinned source census and its discrepancy/rights records for RES-004. Do not use discovery path counts as the entity denominator.
Account for these playable groups and their exact source-version differences: GDI; Brotherhood of Nod.

Account separately for these additional/campaign/neutral groups and forms: civilian/neutral; scripted mission forces; dinosaurs and special-mission objects. Require explicit approved availability/adaptation rather than omission.

Resolve these version and scope deltas: DOS/Gold baseline selection; Covert Operations missions and additions; console-exclusive mission objects routed to RES-019; unused source records distinguished from shipped objects.

Check accepted capability contracts for field harvesting, MCV deployment, sidebar construction, asymmetric production delivery, infantry crush, commando demolition, aircraft rearm, stealth and detection, superweapon charges. Create or link missing capability leaves before writing pack-specific shortcuts.

Run OPS-005/ART-013 work-order expansion for every approved source row. Create bounded behaviour, model, animation, FX/audio, integration and independent-review children under this gate; copy full context and native blockers to each.
Integrate complete faction production/economy/tech graphs, required units/buildings/forms/support powers, source terrain associations and AI use. Keep shared base rows and faction deltas explicit.
Execute every generated entity/state acceptance, full build progression and mirrored/cross-faction scenarios. Include acquisition/ownership transfer and saved-profile behavior where supported.
Reconcile source, runtime, asset, clip, test and evidence sets. Route defects to the exact child; retain all mandatory incomplete rows and mark this gate open.
Publish a versioned family manifest, playable showcase and independent acceptance report for integration into the whole catalogue.
deliverables: Accepted per-family census and source-to-Fusion mapping
Actual generated child issue map for every faction/entity/form/state
Versioned runtime pack, permitted live 3D asset/animation manifests and terrain dependencies
Faction tech/economy/AI scenarios, visual evidence and independent completeness report
acceptance: Every required source row and faction delta has accepted behaviour/art/animation/evidence or an explicit source-limited blocker; no silent drop.
All required production, economy, movement, combat, ability, death/capture/repair/transform states function in the real game.
Exact set reconciliation passes; shared assets remain justified and visually readable rather than inflating unique-asset totals.
Independent reviewer accepts gameplay identity, complete animation and tactical readability at desktop/mobile gameplay zoom.
The gate cannot close while a mandatory generated child is incomplete, rights-blocked for its promised release route or based on an unknown source fact.
guardrails: Research names remain distinct from cleared public branding and distribution choices.
No numerical balance change enters Classic or existing saved profiles through shared pack mutation.
Campaign-only/civilian/unused/faction/source helpers are different categories; record the approved disposition of each.
An early slice proves the pipeline only; it does not close this whole-family gate.
tasks.handoff: Return family and census hashes; real child IDs; source/runtime/art/animation/test set-difference report; build/review evidence; gaps and next exact action.
